Project description: IMT (Individual Market Transition): Worked on the migration of Individual Market Transition (IMT) processes from an external vendor system to Premera’s internal platform. The project involved handling individual user claim enrollment, claim purchasing, and billing functionalities to ensure seamless data integration and improved operational efficiency.
Responsibilities:
Working as a Technical Lead and Team Lead, managing and coordinating a 23-member development team.
Providing technical guidance, architecture support, and issue resolution for the development team.

Supporting the team in L3 support for critical application issues and production incidents, design decisions, improving code quality, and troubleshooting complex technical issues.
Responsible for task allocation, progress tracking, and overall delivery management.

Involved in transitioning the IMT system from a third-party vendor platform to the in-house Premera FACETS system.
Handled individual claim enrollment, purchasing, and billing modules as part of the IMT transition.
Responsible for data migration, process optimization, and system integration to improve performance and ensure compliance with organizational standards.
Key Aspects:

Involved in Requirement Gathering, Estimation, Technical Analysis, Sprint Planning.
Performed code reviews, supported migration of on-premise applications to Azure Cloud, implemented data migration using Azure Data Factory, and monitored Autosys jobs and Integration APIs to ensure smooth system operations.
Project description: APR: its major application. CPP application portal shows status of the users annual pricing rate of product and allows employees to give the pricing rate to the user products.
CNP: its major application. The Client Negotiation (CNP) Portal website will be used by all the client products by employees.
Responsibilities:
Worked as Technical Lead, coordinating development activities and

supporting the team in delivering application enhancements and fixes. Provided technical guidance and design support for the APR and CNP applications.
Collaborated with business stakeholders and product teams to

understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Supported L3 support for critical application issues and production incidents, development, issue analysis, and troubleshooting for critical production issues.
Coordinated with team members to ensure timely delivery of

features and system improvements. Ensured application stability, performance, and compliance with organizational standards.
Key Aspects:
APR (Annual Pricing Rate) Portal: Application used to display the status of users’ annual product pricing rates and enable employees to manage and update pricing rates for customer products.
CNP (Client Negotiation Portal): Web portal used by employees to manage and support client product negotiation activities across multiple products.
Project description: The ALDI supermarket application is our enterprise-wide, end-to-end, space and range transformation program that will optimize how we buy, move and sell. This means our ways of working, processes and systems will be simplified, re-imagined and optimized to deliver benefits to our customers, our people, our suppliers and our business.
Responsibilities: Sprint Planning, Coding, understanding requirements, functional Testing, Designing, Debugging Key Aspects:
• • • Created an Architecture Design for this project. • Created a complete boiler plate
Involved in Estimation, Sprint & Capex Planning Technical analysis and development. Involved Code-Review
Project description: The RSO Program is our enterprise-wide, end-to-end, space and range transformation program that will optimize how we buy, move and sell. This means our ways of working, processes and systems will be simplified, re- imagined and optimized to deliver benefits to our customers, our people, our suppliers and our business. The RSO Program is not just an IT Delivery Program, nor just a range review process, nor a program only for Supermarkets.
Responsibilities: Understanding requirements, prepared unit test cases, Coding, and unit testing. Key Aspects:

I achieved working experience of writing Database stored procedures and triggers
Documented business requirement and create user stories • Analysis of client requirements. • Preparation of Unit Test plan and unit testing of all the WPF development.
Qantas Travel Scape(Travel)
Project description: The Qantas Travel scape is a comprehensive product which gives an end-to-end IT solution for passenger’s travel, lodging, boarding, expense reimbursement and ticket management. This application also connects various internal Strategic Business Units / Travel management Companies (Channel partners) and has a detailed workflow for various levels of approvals.
Responsibilities: Sprint Planning, Coding, understanding requirements, functional Testing, Designing, Debugging Key Aspects:
• • • Created an Architecture Design for this project. • Created a complete boiler plate
Involved in Estimation, Sprint & Capex Planning Technical analysis and development. Involved Code-Review
Project description: We have migrated 123 AIG Applications from windows 2007 to 2010, Main scope of this project is testing, enhancement works in varies technologies. Responsibilities: Sprint Planning, Coding, understanding requirements, functional Testing, Designing, Debugging Key Aspects:
• • • Analyzed 123 windows and web application basic software and hardware requirement.
Involved in Estimation, Sprint & Capex Planning Technical analysis and Testing. Involved to communicate all the application owners
Created environmental setup in Windows 2010 and 2007.
Project description: The Allocation Model is an Excel-based application used by PCG Institutional Asset Management to allocate private placement investments to affiliated and non-affiliated investors in accordance with their contractual agreements. This Excel-based model uses formulas and macros to determine investor appetite and allocates transactions to investors according to a contractual allocation protocol.
Responsibilities: Waterfall Method Planning, Coding, understanding requirements, functional Testing, Designing, Debugging Key Aspects:
• • • Created an Architecture Design for this project.
Involved in Estimation Technical analysis and development. Involved Code-Review
